banglaExplanation: Formative assessment training চলার সময় হয়, trainer নিজেই এটা designed করেন।
এর কাজ feedback দিয়ে শেখায় সাহায্য করা, পাস-ফেল করা নয়।
Summative assessment সাধারণত training-এর শেষে হয়, এটাই formal assessment।
এতে ঠিক হয় trainee competent কি না, আর এটা certification-এর জন্য ব্যবহার হয়।

example.bn: সাপ্তাহিক quiz হলো formative, শেষের সার্টিফিকেট পরীক্ষা হলো summative।
example.en: In an IT course, the trainer gives a quick weekly quiz with feedback. The final competency test leads to a certificate.

short.modelAnswer:
Formative assessment: assists and supports learning by feedback about performance and progress towards competency. It is conducted during training and designed and conducted by the trainer.
Summative assessment: determines whether a trainee has reached competency or achieved learning outcomes. It is for recognition, classification or certification following a training program.

realQuestions.answer:
The purpose of formative assessment is to assist and support learning by providing
feedback about performance and progress towards the achievement of competency.
Formative assessment is conducted during training and is designed and conducted
by the trainer.
The purpose of summative assessment is to determine whether a trainee has
reached competency, or achieved learning outcomes, for the purpose of recognition,
classification or certification following a training program.
realQuestions.label: CBLM 11 Self Check 1 (Q1)
realQuestions.question: Explain the purpose of formative assessment and summative assessment

realQuestions.answer:
Formative assessment gives feedback on progress and
improvement during learning; summative assessment determines achievement or
competence at the end of a defined period.
